title: When Good News Fails in Evolution: A Note on Information, Exposure, and Evolutionary Stability
abstract: arXiv:2611.25205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Good news about a strategy need not translate into evolutionary success. We study how the interaction between information and strategy exposure shapes evolutionary dynamics and equilibrium predictions. We derive the associated population dynamic from a simple revision process in which agents encounter candidate strategies at state-dependent rates and adopt them after receiving favorable payoff signals. We distinguish the monotone likelihood ratio property (MLRP) of signals from effective MLRP, which accounts for exposure relative to population shares and determines whether better-performing strategies grow faster. Random population encounters preserve MLRP and generate payoff-monotone evolution. When exposure sufficiently favors rare strategies, effective MLRP is violated near strict pure Nash equilibria, rendering them unstable. translated_title: 当好消息在演化中失效：关于信息、暴露与演化稳定性的注记
translated_abstract: 关于某一策略的好消息未必能转化为演化上的成功。我们研究信息与策略暴露之间的交互作用如何塑造演化动态与均衡预测。我们从一个简单的修订过程中推导出相应的群体动态：在该过程中，个体以依赖状态的速率遇到候选策略，并在收到有利的收益信号后采纳这些策略。我们将信号的单调似然比性质（MLRP）与“有效MLRP”区分开来，后者考虑了相对于种群份额的暴露程度，并决定了表现更优的策略是否增长更快。随机的种群相遇保持MLRP，从而产生收益单调的演化。当暴露充分偏向稀有策略时，有效MLRP在严格纯策略纳什均衡附近被违反，使其变得不稳定；相反，当暴露充分偏向流行策略时，有效MLRP在非纳什纯策略（状态）附近被违反……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“有效MLRP”这一新概念，揭示信息与策略暴露的交互作用可颠覆收益单调演化——当暴露偏向稀有策略时严格纳什均衡会失去稳定性，而偏向流行策略时非纳什状态反而可能保持稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "effective MLRP," showing that the interaction between information and strategy exposure can overturn payoff-monotone evolution: exposure favoring rare strategies destabilizes strict pure Nash equilibria, while exposure favoring popular strategies can stabilize non-Nash states.
